title: epoch-marker-and-causal-linker-for-low-overhead-request-telemetry
creator: Maya Patel
description: Introduce an "epoch marker" header and an in-band causal linker to provide compact, loss-tolerant request lineage and span stitching across edge, proxy, and runtime boundaries with minimal CPU/rt overhead. Goal: enable reliable cross-service trace reconstruction for sampled and unsampled requests, allow sampling hints to flow end-to-end, and provide deterministic lightweight span enrichment for high-cardinality request attributes without ballooning header sizes. This work touches SDK middleware (Node/Python/Go), edge proxy adapters, runtime ingest hooks, and Console ingestion pipelines.
comments: 2026-02-18 - Spike completed: prototyped 8-byte epoch id + 2-byte flags in Node SDK. Measured ~0.6us additional latency per request on our microbench harness (single-threaded).

2026-02-25 - Design review with Observability and Runtime teams. Decided to use little-endian 8-byte epoch (epoch-id) to minimize parsing cost; header name: X-RW-EPOCH. Agreed sampling hint header X-RW-SAMP (1 byte) for negotiated hints between edge and runtime.

2026-03-02 - Prototype PR opened for Node and Go middleware (https://github.com/redwood-inference/rw-observability/pull/694). Edge adapter implemented to translate existing oc-trace headers to epoch+causal linker when present.

2026-03-05 - Benchmarks against current tracing shim: batching case shows 12% CPU savings in carrier parsing when using compact epoch vs base64 trace-id for high-throughput paths. Streaming/ws path validated with simulated chunk reassembly.

2026-03-08 - Design feedback from Security: confirm epoch header does not contain PII; agreed epoch generation is opaque and per-process salted to prevent correlation across customers. Added KMS-compatible entropy seed option for Private deployments.

2026-03-10 - Blocking: SRE wants integration test in staging to validate sampling alignment combinatorics under pressure (depends on ENG-41239). Next: add Python SDK adapter, complete runtime ingest hook, and add E2E test in telemetry staging pipeline.
acceptance_criteria: Node/Python/Go SDKs include compatible middleware enabling X-RW-EPOCH and X-RW-SAMP exchange without changing public SDK surface area.
Runtime ingest hook accepts epoch header and attaches epoch-id to spans in compact form; no regressions in p95 latency in our nightly perf suite.
Edge adapter translates legacy trace headers to epoch+causal linker when edge config enables compatibility.
Sampling hints are honored end-to-end: edge can request retain/hint and runtime can fall back when capacity constrained; documented behavior in Confluence.
E2E staging test validates span stitching across 3 hops (edge -> proxy -> runtime) under load and shows >=99.9% lineage reconstruction for sampled paths.
Security review sign-off confirming no customer-identifiable data in new headers for Hosted and Dedicated modes.
